svg.text: Section A-A: the cutting plane runs through the centre. Hatching at 45 degrees shows cut material.
Standard parts on the cutting plane (bolts, nuts, washers, pins, rods and springs) are not sectioned. Adjacent parts are hatched in opposite directions.
WBEP Ltd for the health trust
ESP 2025 automated pill dispenser (GA), section A-A
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
